Name: More Gifts from Friends- Enhanced English Edition for Stardew Valley 1.5
Author: HanziTM
Description:
[i]All credits to Logan Doidao! 
This mod is an English version of the Portuguese mod: More Gifts from Friends: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8794?tab=files. [/i]

[img]https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/51213991966_81128fdb98_m.jpg[/img]
Gifting should be reciprocal right? Well now it is! Friends will now give you gifts depending on your friendship level! The deeper the friendship, the better the gifts! It also adds hundreds of lines of dialogue and canon friendly letters from your friends!


[img]https://live.staticflickr.com/65535/51213276502_95d3d235ba_m.jpg[/img]

This enhanced edition includes more NPCs, improved and reworked gifts from friends and reworked dialogue to incorporate character development and personalities into the character. The original only included 3 NPCs. This version includes 10 NPCs (Vanilla game) and it is still being updated for more mods. I plan on adding characters from SVE after I finish adding all the vanilla characters! Tell me which characters I should do next! 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/ZOAQAtz.png[/img]
This mod is compatible ﻿with multiplayer and works with any others mod, there should not be any conflict as this mod adds new letters being sent. 

WARNING:
Do not remove hearts using CJB cheats menu with this mod installed, it causes duplicate letters! Also, this mod does not support the experimental version of Stardew Valley (1.5.5), it only works with the official version (1.5.4)
